newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suspected ETA leader moved to Paris.
newsitem.headline: Suspected ETA leader moved to Paris.

text.p: The presumed number three in the Basque guerrilla group ETA, captured by police in southwestern France, has been transferred to Paris where he remains in custody, police sources said on Saturday.

Jose Luis Urrusolo Sistiaga, who was detained after being stopped at a routine road check near Bordeaux on Thursday night, was moved to the French capital with his wife Gemma. She was picked up on Friday at their home in Miramont-de-Guyenne village in the same region.
Five people who were taken into custody after calling at the house were released on Saturday after questioning, the sources said. Their identities were not revealed.

Urrusolo, among Spain's most wanted men, is suspected of being in charge of training commandos for ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom), which has killed around 800 people since 1968 in its violent campaign for an independent Basque state.

Spain welcomed the arrest as a major step toward peace in the troubled Basque region. Madrid mayor Jose-Maria Alvarez Del Manzano visited Bordeaux, where French Prime Minister Alain Juppe is mayor, to thank him for his government's efforts.
French police who searched Urrusolo's home, found an assault rifle and other arms as well as documents and computer disks, the sources said.

Urrusolo, alias Joseba and known to Spanish police as the "terrorist of a thousand faces", was born in the Spanish Basque city of San Sebastian in 1957. Police suspect him of involvement in killings and kidnappings dating back to the early 1980s.
Cooperation between France and Spain against ETA has led to more than 200 arrests in the past decade and hampered its ability to set up safe houses and arms factories in France.
The two nations recently increased joint meetings of anti- terrorist experts to exchange intelligence on the guerrillas.
France handed over a former ETA leader, Josu Arkauz Arana, to Spanish police this week after he completed a prison sentence in France. He had been in jail since 1991.
